what: The flags that each country of the game flew before the one it flies, by the id of the country. items: its Wikidata entity (wd) and those flags (past), the last to stop flying first: the Commons file of each, its rank when it is the preferred one, and the days Wikidata says it flew between (from, to; ? for a day that is not known). files: what Commons says of each file, by its title: SHA-1, bytes, MIME type, width and height, licence and its address, author, credit, whether it must be attributed, restrictions other than copyright, and its page; where the file is kept in this branch (kept); the 960 px picture that Wikimedia draws of it (picture), which stands for an original of more than 2 MB and goes with a drawing that has words in it (words); for a photograph, the drawing of the same flag that is kept in its place (drawn); and the categories of Commons it is in that speak of other times, of a proposal or of an invention, which may mean that it is not a flag that flies (marks). The files themselves are under flags/files, each named after its SHA-1.
